mechanics: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user explodes forward into a pseudo-strike punch, then fires a blue Ki wave from the opposite hand for a documented 10-hit sequence. Current skill-specific evidence describes the final wave as leaving enough opening for a follow-up ranged Super or fast Ultimate; the move has shorter chase range than Brave Heat and does not track behind the user.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
